Job Title: Software Developer- 1-2 yrs Experience

Key Responsibilities:

Develop, test, and maintain software applications and web solutions. Write clean, efficient, and scalable code using relevant programming languages. Collaborate with the development team to design and implement new features. Debug and troubleshoot technical issues and provide effective solutions. Work with databases, APIs, and third-party integrations as required. Participate in code reviews, testing, and deployment activities. Assist in maintaining and improving existing applications and systems. Follow software development best practices and contribute to cross-functional projects. Assist in business operations and other cross-functional activities as assigned and support branding initiatives

Eligibility Criteria:

Strong knowledge of at least one programming language such as Java, Python, JavaScript, or C#. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work collaboratively and manage multiple tasks effectively. Female candidates preferred.

Job Description

Job Title: Digital Marketing Executive - 1-2 yrs Experience

Key Responsibilities:

Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across social media and online platforms. Create and manage engaging content for social media, websites, and promotional campaigns. Manage social media accounts and monitor audience engagement. Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and identify digital marketing trends. Support SEO, SEM, email marketing, and online advertising activities. Track campaign performance and prepare regular marketing reports. Coordinate with the creative and content teams for campaign execution. Assist in lead generation, brand promotion, and other marketing initiatives.

Eligibility Criteria:

Good understanding of digital marketing, social media, and content marketing. Familiarity with SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and social media management. Basic knowledge of Canva and other content creation tools. Strong communication, analytical, and creative thinking skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively. Female candidates preferred.
